attribution_limitations: The authors state that the patient’s relatively young age at first implantation and multiple prior surgeries "may have contributed" to the tube exposure.
The sentences giving counting-fingers visual acuity and IOP 11 mmHg at the exposure examination do not state which eye was measured.
Trabeculectomy in both eyes was performed one month apart, but the source does not say which eye was operated on first.

"Two years later" for the right eye bleb failure and "Subsequently" after the second GDD are not tied to a named earlier event in their sentences. The sentence joins the bleb failure and the Baerveldt implantation with "and" without stating their order or the implantation time, so they are separate events with no relation between them.

The abstract gives counting-fingers visual acuity and IOP 11 mmHg after the failed amniotic membrane transplant, while the case text gives them at the examination that found the exposure; the time of these measurements is therefore not assigned.
The discussion's "At presentation" (no leakage or endophthalmitis) refers to the tube-exposure presentation, not the initial glaucoma presentation at which the case text also uses "At presentation".
